The structure of MgV4(OF4)4 crystallizes in the monoclinic space group C2/c (No. 15), with a unit cell containing 28 atoms across five independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies V centers as octahedral, coordinated by four F and two O neighbors, while Mg centers have five F neighbors and O centers show four V neighbors. The periodic neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner-sharing between V octahedra and both corner- and edge-sharing between Mg and V polyhedra.
